delivery_note = frappe.form_dict.get("delivery_note")

if not delivery_note:
    frappe.throw("Delivery Note is required")

dn = frappe.get_doc("Delivery Note", delivery_note)

items = []

for d in dn.items:

    used_qty = frappe.db.sql("""
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sb.qty), 0)
        FROM `tabShipment Box` sb
        INNER JOIN `tabShipment` s ON s.name = sb.parent
        WHERE
            s.docstatus = 1
            AND sb.delivery_note = %s
            AND sb.item_code = %s
    """, (delivery_note, d.item_code))[0][0] or 0

    remaining_qty = d.qty - used_qty

    if remaining_qty <= 0:
        continue

    items.append({
        "delivery_note": delivery_note,
        "item_code": d.item_code,
        "item_name": d.item_name,
        "description": d.description,  # ✅ From Delivery Note
        "qty": remaining_qty,
        "uom": d.uom,
        "rate": d.rate,
        "used_qty": used_qty
    })

if not items:
    frappe.throw("All items from this Delivery Note are already fully linked to Shipments")

frappe.response["message"] = items

name: purchase order
script:
purchase_order = frappe.form_dict.get("purchase_order")

if not purchase_order:
    frappe.throw("Purchase Order is required")

po = frappe.get_doc("Purchase Order", purchase_order)

items = []

for d in po.items:

    items.append({
        "item_code": d.item_code,
        "item_name": d.item_name,
        "description": d.description,
        "qty": d.qty,
        "uom": d.uom,
        "rate": d.rate
    })

if not items:
    frappe.throw("No items found in this Purchase Order")

frappe.response["message"] = items
